problem:
Which of the following statements are true?

- If $A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}]$ then $\text{dim(Null}(A))=0.$
- If $B=[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]$ then $\text{dim(Null}(B))=2.$
- If $C=[\begin{aligned}5 & 4 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]$ then $\text{dim(Null}(C))=1.$

Which of the following statements are true?

- If ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14068410/assets/62cc7238e6676b8a43d216ab6c8b30504602c68fd548832eceac9b710b885471.png) then $\textrm{dim(Null}(A))=2$

- If ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14068410/assets/b85d717afa8af39d10517f909a09b53e6d379beef6e04e3d9ce7d3e48c88dca4.png) then $\textrm{dim(Null}(B))=0$

- If ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14068410/assets/8e12a5386c3db2149324bd28c174a5410f7751e0c963cf80969e0cfdf14e5d7b.png) then $\textrm{dim(Null}(C))=1$
examples.worked_solution:
The dimension of the null space of a matrix is the number of non-pivot columns in the matrix. 

Also, all of the given matrices are in row echelon form.

With that in mind, let's consider each of the statements.

- Statement I is false. The matrix $A$ has $2$ pivot columns and $1$ non-pivot column (namely, the $2$nd column). So, 

$$
\textrm{dim(Null}(A))=1.
$$

- Statement II is false. The matrix $B$ has $1$ pivot column and $2$ non-pivot columns (namely, the $2$nd and $3$rd columns). So, 

$$
\textrm{dim(Null}(B))=2.
$$

- Statement III is true. The matrix $C$ has $2$ pivot columns and $1$ non-pivot column (namely, the $3$nd column). So, 

$$
\textrm{dim(Null}(C))=1.
$$

Therefore, only statement III is true.

feedback.problem: Let $R$ be a $8\times 12$ matrix that has $8$ pivot columns. What is the dimension of the null space of $R?$
feedback.worked_solution:
We know that $\text{dim(Null}(R))$ is the number of non-pivot columns in $R.$ 

Since $R$ has $12$ columns and $8$ of them are pivots, then the number of non-pivot columns in $R$ is 

$$
12-8=4.
$$

Therefore, $\text{dim(Null}(R))=4.$
